segments.title: Monday News Desk & Presidential Assassination Attempt Breakdown
segments.notes: Pepito delivers cold open; Case Blackwell anchors solo news desk covering weekend attempted White House shooting, shooter manifesto, and Trump's 60 Minutes interview denial of pedophile/rapist allegations; Abraham Lincoln summoned as guest correspondent to discuss assassination history and afterlife in Blade club.

segments.title: Guy Redacted Investigates the Hufflepuff Vape Conspiracy
segments.notes: Guy Redacted analyzes viral UK vape shop footage featuring 'magical vape' with calculator screen; presents list of luxury vape mods including $2,500 Geppetto Elite V2 and near-million-dollar C3PO Star Wars vape; declares war on comedy skits hiding truth.

segments.title: AI Rooney Complaint Synthesis Stress Test
segments.notes: Case activates AI Rooney to process viewer complaints; Rooney generates surreal rants about health insurance, Spin City, nipple milk, Crash Bandicoot, secret families, and office whiskey dog-bowl rituals; Hype Train briefly interrupts; segment ends with Case threatening to cancel plans.

segments.title: Loon Calls, Fake Sneezes, and Dressing for Your Square Shape
segments.notes: Jeb Nogget and his deceased father (trapped in wood) present barefoot bushcraft loon call tutorial, Kate's fake sneeze tutorial, and 1980s fashion video on dressing for body shapes; Jeb's Dad demands return to Blade rave; Jeb reveals cooking stream goal met.

segments.title: Interview with LA Ozempic Case Blackwell
segments.notes: Case interviews alternate-dimension counterpart who claims success as spokesperson for 'Lucy Bottom Poop Drug' (weekly injectable for digestion) and dating a Sexy Bush Model from Bad Bunny's Super Bowl halftime show; Case cuts off the bit.

segments.title: Frogman Musical Finale & Loveland Cryptid Bill
segments.notes: DJ Newsic airs WCPO clip on Ohio bill to make Loveland Frogman state cryptid; Ben Hooper Weekend Odds and Ends segment on oil-rig stowaway bunnies; Frogman appears live on roof for frog-type beat freestyle; stream ends with frog raid on tea latte.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored solo news desk, summoned Abraham Lincoln, hosted AI Rooney stress test, interviewed alternate-dimension Ozempic self.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive Producer. Delivered live cold open and countdown from dog producer role.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: In-Studio Contributor. Walked through studio wearing Don Quixote shirt, prompting theme song and discussion of Japanese discount store chain.

characters.name: Abraham Lincoln
characters.notes: Guest Correspondent. Summoned as spectral correspondent; debated assassination quality, revealed afterlife is Blade club, wrestled with Mary Todd references.

characters.name: Guy Redacted
characters.notes: Conspiracy Correspondent. Presented Hufflepuff vape conspiracy, luxury vape market exposé, and anti-comedy manifesto.

characters.name: AI Rooney
characters.notes: Automated Grievance Synthesizer. Processed ten viewer complaints into surreal monologues referencing Medicare Part D, Spin City, and office dog-bowl whiskey rituals.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Musical Interruption. Briefly derailed AI Rooney segment with freestyle rap before being muted.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: Instructional Host. Hosted How To with Jeb alongside deceased father; demonstrated loon call failure, fake sneeze, and fashion advice for square shapes.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: Co-Host (Deceased). Spirit trapped in wooden board; bickered with Jeb, demanded return to Blade rave afterlife, provided horror beat for fake sneeze.

characters.name: LA Ozempic Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Alternate-Dimension Correspondent. Claimed to be successful Ozempic spokesperson for 'Lucy Bottom Poop Drug' and dating a Sexy Bush Model from Bad Bunny halftime show.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: Musical Finale Host. Closed broadcast with Loveland Frogman cryptid bill coverage, Ben Hooper bunny rescue clip, and live Frogman freestyle on roof.

characters.name: Frogman
characters.notes: Musical Guest / Cryptid. Appeared on roof for frog-type beat freestyle; claimed green translucent skin and hydrant communication.

lore_notes.fact: Case Blackwell confirms he is 39 years old during age discussion.
Case Blackwell references a wife (likely Kendelle) when stating AI Rooney nearly caused her to 're-divorce' him.
Jeb Nogget achieved his cooking stream goal.
Jeb's Dad's spirit remains trapped in the wooden board and desires to return to the 'Blade rave in the sky' afterlife.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered the chaotic weekend attempted assassination at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, featuring a nude shooter's ChatGPT-style manifesto and Trump's combative 60 Minutes denial. The broadcast spiraled through a Guy Redacted vape conspiracy deep-dive, an AI Rooney complaint synthesis meltdown, Jeb Nogget's instructional failures with his deceased father, and an interview with a suspiciously smooth alternate-dimension Case Blackwell. The episode concluded with DJ Newsic's musical tribute to the Loveland Frogman's pending Ohio state cryptid designation and a live roof freestyle from the cryptid himself.
